payload.rationale: fgos return left a 3.3 GB verify checkout under /tmp/fgos-worktrees because worktree remove refused on ignored build output. Fixed by beb817c68 (test) and d0d03e683 (fix), OPC MERGE; proven live on design-lap release 29ea8197: fgos approve re-verify left no verify-* dir
payload.text: A verify checkout is removed together with the ignored bytes its own check produced (Cargo output, regenerated skills); every other checkout keeps the ignored-bytes refusal
